decisions.reason: The accent must still derive from the Hero V geometry; refining that source geometry does not change the accent's derivation rule or required consistency.
The closing V remains derived from the Hero V geometry. The selected Hero V arm relationship does not alter that derivation rule or its shared-characteristics requirement.
The source discusses the left and right arms of the Hero V, not the deferred E and L letterforms.
The source refines monochrome Hero V geometry and makes no decision about the deferred champagne material treatment.
Refining the Hero V arm relationship does not change the deferred requirement for cohesive full-wordmark kerning.
The source selects geometric characteristics for the Hero V but does not change the closing V's smaller, subordinate visual prominence.
The source contains design feedback only and does not change acceptable proof formats or Mac-viewability requirements.
